reader.requirement: At --std 85 a report file (an FD carrying a REPORT clause) must be named by exactly one SELECT in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph of its own program: a second SELECT of the same name, an FD with REPORT that no SELECT names, and a SELECT with no FD in the same program (including one whose FD sits in a contained program) are each refused.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 requires record entries for a non-report FD; returns before the switch for a report file

reader.edition-search: The three refusals (COBOL2634 FileNameSelectedTwice, COBOL2636 FileDescriptionWithoutSelect, COBOL2635 SelectWithoutFileDescription) are gated only by `screened` (not a class definition), never by edition; grepped the FileControlBinder partials for DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry|IsAvailable.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses check the general SELECT/FD pairing and legal report FDs; a report file selected twice and a report FD with no SELECT are not exercised for a report file

probes.printed: r3twice.cob(7,12): error COBOL2634: file-name 'RPF' is specified in a second SELECT clause
r4noselect.cob(11,8): error COBOL2636: file description entry 'RPF' names a file that no file control entry specifies
probes.expected: refused: a report file described must be specified in FILE-CONTROL

probes.printed: r5nofd.cob(7,12): error COBOL2635: file 'RPG' is specified in a SELECT clause but has no file description entry
probes.expected: refused: the selected file needs its FD

probes.printed: COBOL2635 at (6,12) for the outer SELECT and COBOL2636 at (18,8) for the contained program's FD RPF REPORT IS RPT
probes.expected: refused: the FD must be in the same program
two report files, each selected once with an FD carrying REPORT IS / REPORTS ARE, compile and run

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.2.3.3 SR2  (2.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: The second sentence is definitional (a report file is the subject of an FD with a REPORT clause), so its testable content is that the SELECT has its FD in the same program; both directions are refused. Diagnostics cite §2023 clauses at --std 85; the behaviour matches the 1985 text.

refuter.evidence: Probe s3nested.cob at --std 85: an outer program and a contained program each SELECT RPF with their own FD RPF REPORT IS RPT / RPT2 (same file-name, separate programs) compiles and runs OUT=00 IN=00 with S3A.RPT=OUTER and S3B.RPT=INNER, so 'specified only once' is applied per program, not across the nest (no over-rejection); the reader's r3/r4/r5/r8 cover the refusals (twice, FD without SELECT, SELECT without FD, FD in a contained program). 'must have a file description entry containing a REPORT clause in the Data Division of the same program' (OK §1985:XIII.2.3.3 SR2).
